items.current_state: SSC-02 explicitly does not provide a ten-year external immutable escrow backend.
items.required_action: Introduce a backend-neutral content-addressed escrow adapter in a later LRD implementation stage.

items.current_state: Repository CI does not prove ten-year archival durability or multi-location retention.
items.required_action: Require independently durable immutable locations plus restore evidence outside repository authority.

items.current_state: Authorization semantics have a content-addressed policy snapshot and deterministic reconstruction.
items.required_action: Bind the exact authorization policy snapshot into the long-range execution-closure manifest.

items.current_state: CCL records the canonicalization profile and preserved source contains its implementation.
items.required_action: Bind profile identity and preserved implementation material into the replay capsule.

items.current_state: Replay binds code SHA and SSC-02 preserves an exact source archive bound to the full Git SHA.
items.required_action: Reference logical code identity and physical source-archive artifact identity together.

items.current_state: RuntimeIdentity binds config_digest but generic exact configuration bytes are not preserved by Replay v2.
items.required_action: Escrow exact replay-relevant configuration artifacts or declare the execution unverifiable.

items.current_state: CRY-01 makes algorithm and trust-set identities explicit and rejects unknown algorithms.
items.required_action: Bind exact crypto profile and trust-set identity into long-range verification material.

items.current_state: Historical identity preservation exists but a generic LRD renewal-attestation artifact is not implemented.
items.required_action: Add immutable renewal attestations referencing original artifact digests without rewriting history.

items.current_state: SSC-02 binds resolved dependencies and physically preserves the wheelhouse used for recovery.
items.required_action: Reference the continuity-bundle digest from the long-range replay manifest.

items.current_state: Replay v2 embeds canonical epistemic and trust policy snapshots and binds their identities.
items.required_action: Reuse existing policy snapshots and do not create parallel policy authority.

items.current_state: Replay v2 binds input and evidence digests but arbitrary original bytes are not universally escrowed.
items.required_action: Preserve every replay-critical input and evidence artifact by content address or return UNVERIFIABLE.

items.current_state: Replay v2 does not claim deterministic rerun of arbitrary provider or model execution without captured artifacts.
items.required_action: Preserve exact external responses as immutable content-addressed downstream replay inputs.

items.current_state: Provider and model identities are declared but generic exact request payloads are not preserved.
items.required_action: Capture canonical request bytes and exact provider model version and capability identity.

items.current_state: SSC-02 preserves pyproject PEP-751 pylock and uv.lock identities and physical files.
items.required_action: Bind continuity-bundle identity and lockfile digests into the replay capsule.

items.current_state: Replay v2 embeds migration-registry topology and exact implementation remains bound to preserved code.
items.required_action: Require one explicit deterministic route and reject missing cyclic or ambiguous routes.

items.current_state: SSC-02 proves no-index recovery but a generic LRD runner with enforced network-off semantics is absent.
items.required_action: Add a least-privilege replay runner that fails on network access in declared offline mode.

items.current_state: SSC-02 includes a standalone standard-library verifier inside the continuity bundle.
items.required_action: Reuse preserved verifier material and add LRD capsule verification without current LUKART dependency.

items.current_state: RuntimeIdentity binds plugin identities but exact executable plugin artifacts are not universally escrowed.
items.required_action: Escrow plugin artifacts and capability manifests whenever they affect replay semantics.

items.current_state: RuntimeIdentity binds provider and model identities while the providers remain external dependencies.
items.required_action: Separate identity verification from reproducibility and use preserved responses for Frozen Path.

items.current_state: RuntimeIdentity records Python and platform metadata but the exact interpreter is not generically escrowed.
items.required_action: Preserve an executable runtime artifact or a verifiable reconstruction recipe with exact artifacts.

items.current_state: Replay v2 stops at epistemic and trust verification and does not bind a dedicated renderer identity.
items.required_action: Bind renderer identity separately so presentation drift cannot become semantic failure.

items.current_state: SBOM generation exists but SSC-02 does not claim physical preservation of every historical SBOM artifact.
items.required_action: Preserve the exact SBOM and bind its digest when it participates in execution-closure evidence.

items.current_state: Replay v2 binds schema identities and preserved exact source contains their implementations.
items.required_action: Require all replay-critical schema identities in the long-range manifest.

items.current_state: Deterministic projection identities exist but a canonical final semantic-result identity is not yet an LRD contract.
items.required_action: Define canonical semantic-result identity independently from renderer and presentation bytes.

items.current_state: SSC-02 preserves an exact Git source archive with a full-SHA binding.
items.required_action: Reference the content-addressed source archive from Frozen Path closure material.

items.current_state: DR-02 defines content-addressed source and target storage profiles plus recovery-conformance evidence.
items.required_action: Bind source storage identity while keeping backend location outside Product authority.

items.current_state: Historical artifacts are immutable but generic Replay Capsule supersedes_digest lineage is not implemented.
items.required_action: Make published capsules immutable and represent corrections as new capsules pointing to old digests.

items.current_state: Case identity and enterprise isolation exist but the future LRD runner has no dedicated zero-write scope contract.
items.required_action: Enforce read-only exact case scope and reject mixed tenant or case material during verification.

items.current_state: Trust-set and verification identities are explicit but generic LRD preservation is not guaranteed.
items.required_action: Preserve exact public verification material trust-set snapshots and receipts by content address.

items.current_state: SSC-02 preserves a physical wheelhouse but not every possible sdist or direct-source artifact generically.
items.required_action: Require every executable dependency source to be physically escrowed or fail closed.
